description: Revoke one worker by label: its pass stops verifying at once and the label is never issued again. Needs your own pass. Configure Authorization: Bearer <pass> in your MCP client and omit the pass argument whenever headers are supported. The pass argument is a sensitive compatibility fallback for clients without header support. Arguments and credential-bearing results, including invoice, claim, free-tier claim and recovery results, may persist in client transcripts. Keep them private. A header takes precedence; conflicting credentials are refused.
